# AI Engineer – Job Description

## Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate should have experience building scalable AI solutions, integrating LLMs, and working with modern AI frameworks.

## Responsibilities

* Design and develop AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
* Build and deploy LLM-powered applications using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or open-source models.
* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Create AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.
* Fine-tune and evaluate machine learning models.
* Design prompt engineering strategies for better AI responses.
* Integrate vector databases such as FAISS, ChromaDB, Pinecone, or Weaviate.
* Develop REST APIs for AI services.
* Deploy AI applications on cloud platforms.
* Monitor model performance and optimize inference costs.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and software engineers.
* Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, and reliable.

## Required Skills

### Programming

* Python
* JavaScript/TypeScript
* SQL

### AI & Machine Learning

* Machine Learning fundamentals
* Deep Learning
* Neural Networks
* NLP
* Transformers
* LLMs
* Prompt Engineering

### Generative AI

* OpenAI API
* Claude API
* Gemini API
* Llama Models
* RAG
* AI Agents
* Function Calling
* Structured Output

### Frameworks

* LangChain
* LangGraph
* LlamaIndex
* Hugging Face Transformers

### Vector Databases

* FAISS
* ChromaDB
* Pinecone
* Weaviate

### Backend Development

* FastAPI
* Flask
* Django
* REST APIs

### Databases

* PostgreSQL
* MySQL
* MongoDB

### Cloud & DevOps

* AWS
* Azure
* Google Cloud
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* CI/CD

## Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
* Experience with production AI systems.
* Knowledge of model evaluation techniques.
* Understanding of AI safety and responsible AI practices.
* Experience with distributed systems and scalable architectures.

## Interview Topics

### Python

* OOP
* Decorators
* Generators
* Async/Await
* Multithreading vs Multiprocessing

### Machine Learning

* Supervised vs Unsupervised Learning
* Bias-Variance Tradeoff
* Overfitting vs Underfitting
* Cross Validation
* Evaluation Metrics

### Deep Learning

* CNN
* RNN
* LSTM
* Attention Mechanism
* Transformers

### Generative AI

* LLM Architecture
* Tokenization
* Embeddings
* Vector Database
* RAG
* Fine-Tuning
* Prompt Engineering
* Hallucination
* AI Agents

### System Design

* Design a Chatbot
* Design a RAG Application
* Design an AI Agent
* LLM Scaling Strategies
* Caching and Cost Optimization

## Nice to Have

* LangSmith
* MLflow
* TensorFlow
* PyTorch
* CrewAI
* AutoGen
* MCP (Model Context Protocol)
* Agentic AI Workflows

## Sample Resume Headline

**AI Engineer | Generative AI | LangChain | LangGraph | RAG | LLMs | Python | FastAPI | Vector Databases | AWS**

For a **2–3 years experienced AI Engineer**, companies commonly expect: Python, LLMs, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, FastAPI, Docker, and Cloud deployment.
